concept: Athena: serverless SQL over data in S3
tests: Choosing a service for ad hoc serverless SQL queries over an S3 data lake with pay-per-query pricing.
expected: Amazon Athena: serverless, SQL directly on S3, pay per data scanned. Triggers: "ad hoc SQL", "directly on S3", "without provisioning servers", "pay per query".
why_not: Redshift provisioned and EMR mean managing and paying for running clusters; RDS is OLTP, not queries over S3 files.
